items.title: Apple releases Depth Pro 2 for sharp, temporally consistent depth
items.summary: Depth Pro 2 is an approach to estimating dense metric depth for images and video at full resolution, using a single, scalable network that processes both images and video and predicts depth maps at native resolution. The authors report that it produces depth maps that are metrically accurate, sharp, and temporally consistent at once, and they release code and weights.

evidence.quote: Richter, Vladlen Koltun View publication View source code (GitHub) Copy Bibtex We present Depth Pro 2, an approach to estimating dense metric depth for images and video at full resolution.
To overcome this trade-off, we train a single, scalable network that processes both images and video and predicts depth maps at native resolution.
Depth Pro 2 produces depth maps that are metrically accurate, sharp, and temporally consistent all at once, outperforming prior work in all of these dimensions.
We release code and weights here .
Depth Pro 2 estimates the depth of every pixel, in meters, from images taken with an ordinary camera.

items.title: Transformers v5.24.0 adds Inkling 2 Mini, Apertus 1.5, and Omnilingual ASR
items.summary: The v5.24.0 release adds Inkling 2 Mini, a multimodal model from Thinking Machines Lab that accepts text and image inputs and generates text outputs, and Apertus 1.5, a multimodal model from the Swiss AI Initiative that accepts text, images and audio. It also adds Omnilingual ASR, a suite of multilingual speech-recognition models from Meta FAIR covering more than 1,600 languages, and renames past_key_values and cache_params to cache while keeping the old names working with a deprecation warning.

evidence.quote: Inkling 2 Mini is a multimodal model from Thinking Machines Lab that accepts text and image inputs and generates text outputs.
Apertus 1.5 is a multimodal model from the Swiss AI Initiative that accepts text, images and audio and generates text.
Omnilingual ASR is a suite of multilingual speech-recognition models from Meta FAIR that covers more than 1,600 languages.
Cache renaming: past_key_values / cache_params → cache ( #50585 , #50730 )
The old names still work with a deprecation warning; see the dedicated section below.
Fully backward compatible for now : past_key_values= / cache_params= are renamed to cache automatically, with a one-time deprecation warning.

items.title: Sage S2.1 Flash report: 320-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model
items.summary: The report introduces Sage S1.5 Flash, a 320-billion-parameter general-purpose mixture-of-experts model designed to reason over scientific evidence and act in interactive environments, with dedicated encoders for molecular graphs and biological sequences. It is evaluated on 33 benchmarks across seven domains, ranking first on OfficeQA Pro (72.2), MLE-bench Lite (90.3 HumanRank), Harvey LAB, and SpreadsheetBench~2 in the primary comparison against five baselines.

items.title: Olala-v1.0-mini-7A1B: a small reasoning model with 1B active parameters
items.summary: Olala-v1.0-mini-7A1B is a small reasoning model for chat, instruction following and tool use, built on a hybrid Mamba-3 / attention mixture-of-experts architecture with 6.8B total parameters and about 1B active per token. It offers four reasoning-effort levels and a 32K token (input + output) context, with a 128K-context version coming soon, though Ollama, LM Studio and the official llama.cpp, vLLM and mlx-lm cannot load it yet.

items.title: pi-H3 generates MiniMax H3 videos in 2–4 steps without a VAE decoder
items.summary: pi-H3 provides 2-step and 4-step adapters of MiniMax H3 for generating videos with synchronized audio, combining pi-Flow v2 few-step distillation with DWD (Decoding Without a Decoder), which predicts video frames directly at the last step. All adapters support text, first-frame, and last-frame conditioning, and the INT8 ConvRot versions are for ComfyUI only.

evidence.quote: image = pipe(prompt).images[0] Notebooks Google Colab Kaggle pi-H3: Video Generation in 2–4 Steps Without a VAE Decoder Models Usage Diffusers ComfyUI License Citation
2-step and 4-step adapters of MiniMax H3 , the fastest way to generate MiniMax H3 videos with synchronized audio.
pi-H3 combines pi-Flow v2 few-step distillation with DWD (Decoding Without a Decoder), which predicts the video frames directly at the last step, so the video skips the VAE decoder.
All adapters support text, first-frame, and last-frame conditioning.
We recommend the DWD adapters.
The INT8 ConvRot versions are for ComfyUI only.

items.title: InclusionMed benchmarks frontier models for inclusive healthcare
items.summary: InclusionMed is an open medical AI evaluation initiative whose Atlas organizes benchmarks across three healthcare roles and three AI capabilities, with four public benchmarks selected from 388 candidates and a private diagnostic reasoning benchmark bringing the total to five. Frontier large language models scored from 17.5 to 49.1 out of 100 on the InclusionMed Index, and the ten highest-ranked models all scored higher on patient communication than on clinical decision-making.

evidence.quote: We introduce InclusionMed, an open medical AI evaluation initiative for inclusive healthcare.
The InclusionMed Atlas organizes benchmarks across three healthcare roles and three AI capabilities.
For the first release, we selected four public benchmarks from 388 candidates through structured audits and independent reproduction.
With InclusionMed-DxFiles , our private diagnostic reasoning benchmark , the Atlas contains five benchmarks covering three of its nine role--capability cells.
We evaluated frontier large language models on the Atlas and aggregated their results into the InclusionMed Index , with overall scores ranging from 17.5 to 49.1 out of 100.

items.title: AscendGYM benchmarks cost-aware Ascend NPU kernel optimization
items.summary: AscendGYM is a benchmark whose initial suite comprises 48 kernels across three difficulty levels, each paired with test cases whose data types and tensor shapes are collected from real-world training and inference tasks. It supports model evaluation and model-harness evaluation, and introduces the Speedup-Token Score (STS), which quantifies performance gains relative to token cost.

evidence.quote: Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Kernel optimization is essential for efficient large language model (LLM) training and inference on Ascend NPUs .
To address this requirement, we introduce AscendGYM, a benchmark whose initial suite comprises 48 kernels across three difficulty levels.
Each kernel is paired with test cases whose data types and tensor shapes are collected from real-world training and inference tasks.
In terms of usability, two evaluation modes are supported in AscendGYM: model evaluation and model-harness evaluation .
Finally, we propose a new metric, the Speedup-Token Score (STS) , which quantifies performance gains relative to token cost .

items.title: VibePrevisBench tests agentic 4D scene generation in Blender
items.summary: VibePrevisBench is a benchmark for 4D scene reconstruction in which an agent turns a brief into an executable 4D scene and renders its proxy video, spanning 242 tasks across four input kinds. It scores deliveries with a rule-based Scene Check that compares the exported scene against hidden ground truth facts in nine dimensions and a VLM-based Screen Check, and the authors analyze the results and trajectories of 11 frontier coding agents.

items.title: Researchers propose agentic robotics framework and evaluation approach
items.summary: The paper argues that Embodied System 2, realized by a foundation model together with an embodied harness, forms the decision-making core of agentic robotics, where an agent observes, reasons, invokes skills and tools, verifies outcomes, and adapts its strategy. Motivated by this perspective, the authors propose an evaluation framework measuring both model capabilities and closed-loop system performance, along with a research roadmap for reliable physical autonomy.

evidence.quote: Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash The release of GPT-6 Astra marks the emergence of a new paradigm in robotics: agentic robotics .
Within weeks, frontier models with agentic harnesses matched or exceeded task-specific policies on many embodied benchmarks .
Despite these advances, the community has yet to converge on a shared definition, a reliable evaluation framework, or a research roadmap.
We argue that Embodied System 2 , realized by a foundation model together with an embodied harness , forms the decision-making core of agentic robotics .
Motivated by this perspective, we propose an evaluation framework that measures both model capabilities and closed-loop system performance.

items.title: CLI-Anything makes software agent-native through a CLI hub
items.summary: CLI-Anything bridges the gap between AI agents and the world's software by making any program agent-ready through one command line, for tools such as Pi, OpenClaw, nanobot, Cursor, and Claude Code. Its CLI-Hub can be installed with pip install cli-anything-hub, then cli-hub install <name>, to browse, install, and manage community-built CLIs.

items.title: Superpowers gives coding agents a composable skills methodology
items.summary: Superpowers is a software development methodology for coding agents built on composable skills and initial instructions that ensure the agent uses them, covering design sign-off, implementation planning, and subagent-driven development with inspection and review. It emphasizes true red/green TDD, YAGNI (You Aren't Gonna Need It), and DRY, and its skills trigger automatically.

evidence.quote: Superpowers is a complete software development methodology for your coding agents, built on top of a set of composable skills and some initial instructions that make sure your agent uses them.
Instead, it steps back and asks you what you're really trying to do.

After you've signed off on the design, your agent puts together an implementation plan that's clear enough for an enthusiastic junior engineer with poor taste, no judgement, no project context, and an aversion to testing to follow.
It emphasizes true red/green TDD, YAGNI (You Aren't Gonna Need It), and DRY.
Next up, once you say "go", it launches a subagent-driven-development process, having agents work through each engineering task, inspecting and reviewing their work, and continuing forward.
And because the skills trigger automatically, you don't need to do anything special.

items.title: Firecrawl runs locally as a self-hosted scraping and search API
items.summary: The Firecrawl repository holds the code for Firecrawl Local and the self-hosted server along with SDKs, letting users run Firecrawl on their own machine as one binary that turns websites into clean markdown and plugs into an AI agent as an MCP server. It serves the Firecrawl v2 API on port 3002 so existing code runs against it unchanged and local routes need no API key, while the hosted service adds search and the 550+ data providers in Firecrawl Alexandria.

evidence.quote: This repo holds the code for Firecrawl Local and the self-hosted server, along with SDKs that work with all three.
Run Firecrawl on your own machine as one binary that turns websites into clean markdown, plugs into your AI agent as an MCP server and serves the Firecrawl API on localhost.

Use the hosted service at firecrawl.dev for everything Local does at scale with nothing to run, plus search and the 550+ data providers in Firecrawl Alexandria for far more knowledge than scraping alone.

items.title: ClawDOS runs an AI coding agent on an IBM PC XT
items.summary: ClawDOS is an AI coding agent that runs on an IBM PC XT with an 8088 at 4.77 MHz, 640K of RAM, and a CGA card. The harness runs on the native OS and hardware and relies on a "bridge" PC to handle TLS, while HARNESS.EXE is a 176 KB DOS program built from 13,000 lines of C and C++ with Open Watcom for the 8086 instruction set.
